answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24371 Country: United States of America Title: As a Muslim woman am I able to uncover my hair in front of known homosexuals? Question: As a Muslim woman am I able to uncover my hair in front of known homosexuals? Your sister in Islam Mariam Answer ID: 24371 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1193/1193/M=1431) It is not lawful for a woman to uncover her hair in front of non-mahram male without a valid reason, though he is an acquaintance or a stranger. It is necessary to cover the hair as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
